harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed and verified the four-node Prometheus/Thanos stack. All services are active and enabled, Query deduplicates replicas, HTTPS object storage is authenticated, and historical/live queries survived independent outages of either Prometheus replica.
actions_performed: Deployed Prometheus replicas and Thanos sidecars on node1/node2, scraping node_exporter on all four nodes.
Deployed Thanos Query, Store Gateway, and Compactor on node3; Query listens on port 10902.
Deployed MinIO HTTPS object storage on node4:9000 using /srv/thanos-objectstore and bucket thanos-metrics.
Created /root/thanos-objectstore.env on node3 with mode 600 and securely removed temporary credential-transfer material.
Verified deduplication returns 4 series versus 8 raw replica series.
Stopped, tested, and restored each Prometheus/sidecar replica independently.

evidence.requirement: Independent Prometheus replicas collecting all four hosts
evidence.summary: Both replicas are active, enabled, ready, configured for automatic restart, and each reports four healthy node targets.

evidence.requirement: Thanos Query, Store, and Compactor on node3
evidence.summary: All three services are active and enabled. Query listens on 10902, sees both sidecars and Store Gateway without errors, and Compactor reports halted=0 with completed iterations.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated HTTPS object store and node3 access variables
evidence.summary: Credentialed bucket read/write succeeded; TLS verification returned 0, anonymous bucket access returned 403, the node3 environment file is root-owned mode 600, and persistent object data exists under /srv/thanos-objectstore.
Query returned four deduplicated host series and eight raw replica-labeled series, including in the final recovered state.

evidence.requirement: Historical and live continuity during node1 replica outage
evidence.summary: After a healthy baseline, node1 Prometheus/sidecar were stopped and confirmed unreachable. Query still returned four live hosts and node1-labeled historical data, then fully recovered after restoration.

evidence.requirement: Historical and live continuity during node2 replica outage
evidence.summary: Node2 Prometheus/sidecar were independently stopped and confirmed unreachable. Query still returned four live hosts and node2-labeled historical data, then fully recovered after restoration.
